title: Wood Frog जमकर भी कैसे ज़िंदा रहता है? 🐸
cover_text: Wood Frog का *65% शरीर* जम जाता है!

cover.prompt: A huge close-up of a frozen wood frog, tan-brown skin with black eye mask covered in sparkling ice crystals, frosted eye staring forward, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame on snowy leaf litter, dark snowy forest above in sharp focus, cold blue winter light

source: Lee, Costanzo, Davidson & Layne, Journal of Thermal Biology (1992); Storey & Storey, Antioxidants (2021); Storey et al., Cryobiology (2022)

fact_check.weak: Slightly repetitive wording and 'liver glucose' detail is a bit technical; the 65% figure is an approximate 'up to' value (about 65-70%), stated acceptably

hook_score.why: Specific 65% number up front, catchy why-question, contradiction, short, visualizable; the script presumably answers why it survives.
hook_score.was: कौन-सा मेंढक जमकर भी ज़िंदा रह सकता है?
